intel.title: [CISA KEV] Atlassian Multiple Products - Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-21589
廠商: Atlassian
產品: Multiple Products
漏洞名稱: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
說明: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-18
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 已將漏洞 CVE-2026-21589 列入已知利用清單，該漏洞影響包含 Jira 在內的 Atlassian 多款產品。未授權的外部攻擊者可藉由此漏洞存取 Web 應用程式根目錄中的特定檔案，可能導致敏感資訊外洩。由於公司資產包含 Jira 且該漏洞已有活躍攻擊，具高風險威脅。
analysis.recommendation: 請 WF10 部門立即確認內部 Jira 系統版本，並依據 Atlassian 官方安全公告升級至修補版本。若暫時無法進行版本更新，應依官方建議實施存取控制與緩解措施，並於 2026-10-18 前完成修補作業。
